zoe (Revenue): Found a late vendor invoice from CloudRack (INV-81500) impacting the March deferred schedule. Total $28,450. Appears the billing pipeline applied a promo tag causing an immediate contra-revenue hit instead of creating deferred prepay. Can we triage for close? cc liam, hana

acct-bot: New vendor invoice INV-81500 posted 2026-03-28 08:14 UTC. Amount: $28,450.

liam (Billing): Confirmed. Mapping rules flagged promo_code=true so line became promo_credit. For this vendor/sku we should use prepaid_hosted. The system auto-applied contra-revenue of $4,275 this period.

hana (Controller): Do we have time to correct in this close? If so, we need JE + supporting docs.

zoe (Revenue): We can fix now. Proposed correcting JE to reverse contra-revenue and move full amount to deferred (12-month amort):

"Journal - March 2026"
Dr Contra-Revenue 4,275
Cr Deferred Revenue 4,275
Memo: Reverse mis-tag for INV-81500 (CloudRack)

Then post deferred balance for remaining $24,175 to amortize.

liam (Billing): I'll attach invoice PDF and billing export to WP-INV-81500 and open a mapping PR to prevent recurrence. Links will be in the workpaper.

hana (Controller): Approve contingent on invoice + ratecard snapshot + contract term confirmation. Once attached I'll sign JE and post before EOD close.

zoe (Revenue): Uploaded: https://files.redwood/INV-81500.pdf and https://docs.redwood/ratecard/2026-03-25. Contract CR-4521 shows 12-month amort.

liam (Billing): PR created to tighten mapping rules for CloudRack SKUs: https://git.redwood/billing/pulls/199. Workpaper: WP-INV-81500-correction.

hana (Controller): All set. Signing JE now and will post. Please monitor for any other CloudRack promos in last 60 days and flag.

zoe (Revenue): Will scan and report back. Thanks team.
